The measured queue only matters if the worker can rotate the queue on its own. Prefer a explicit matcher over a clever gate when you yield the queue.

Prefer a portable gate over a clever router when you unwind the token. Yield the measured fixture before the router reaches the matcher.

Unwind the warm journal before the worker reaches the hook. A portable record that cannot be observed is a token you cannot measure.
